note: Expected verdicts, decided by hand from the fixture source code before running the tool.

app-like.CVE-2026-89407: BigDecimal exists only in a response DTO (ProductResponse) that is built with new and returned; nothing names it to Jackson (no root, class literal, TypeReference, Jackson annotation value or @Cacheable) -> unreachable
app-like.CVE-2025-14813/CVE-2026-8763: bcprov is reachable through Spring Security Argon2, but not the GOST CTR / name-constraint code
app-like.CVE-2026-65637: no HTTP/2 setting or code; Spring Boot 4 registers Http2Protocol only when server.http2.enabled is true
app-like.CVE-2026-5598: no FrodoKEM use and no JCE name "Frodo"

app-positive.CVE-2026-65182: app adds container constraints; whether the misordered pattern shape matters needs a human -> unknown by design
app-positive.CVE-2026-13506: Asn1Lazy parses with ASN1InputStream(der, true) and walks ASN1Sequence.getObjects() -> LazyEncodedSequence.getObjects/force
app-positive.CVE-2026-0636: LdapCertLookup creates LDAPStoreHelper and searches by subject
app-positive.CVE-2026-19032: ExtraController.export binds ExportRequest with a java.nio.file.Path field
app-positive.CVE-2026-83557: ExtraController.sort binds SortRequest with @JsonTypeInfo on a Comparable field
app-positive.CVE-2026-65637: Http2Customizer adds Http2Protocol to the connector; whether Tomcat terminates TLS needs a human -> unknown by design

app-tokens.CVE-2026-89407: PriceQuote (BigDecimal) is deserialised through a generic helper; no root sees it, but the class literal in QuoteConsumer names it -> unknown, a human must check where the JSON comes from

app-indirect.all: same conditions as app-positive reached a different way: DigestAuthenticator/FormAuthenticator subclasses, HttpMethodConstraintElement, @ServletSecurity, JCE name GOST3412-2015/CTR, addProvider(BC) + CertPathBuilder 'BC', BigDecimal in List<Line>, Duration in a nested record, @JsonTypeInfo(defaultImpl) on a field, ObjectReader.readValue(DataInput)
app-indirect.CVE-2026-91777: the @RequestBody root itself is Map<String, Account> with @JsonIdentityInfo on Account (container root, no wrapper DTO)
app-indirect.CVE-2026-0636: CertStore.getInstance("LDAP", JDK LDAPCertStoreParameters, "BC"): the provider table picks the vulnerable store by reflection and no BC LDAP class is referenced, so unknown (not unreachable)
app-indirect.CVE-2026-83557: @JsonTypeInfo is used (PetRequest.pet) but on a non-Comparable base type: a human must check base types and validators -> unknown
app-indirect.CVE-2026-65637: resources/application.properties sets server.http2.enabled=true and server.ssl.key-store: HTTP/2 on a TLS connector, by configuration only
app-indirect.CVE-2026-5598: FrodoByJceName uses KeyPairGenerator.getInstance("Frodo", "BCPQC"): chosen by name, so unknown (not unreachable)

app-blindspots.CVE-2025-14813: KNOWN MISS: G3413CTRBlockCipher created by Class.forName; reflection is not modelled. If this starts failing, the limitation was lifted: update README
app-blindspots.CVE-2026-89407: KNOWN MISS: readValue(json, Class.forName(name)); the BigDecimal type is never named in bytecode
app-blindspots.CVE-2026-91777: @JsonIdentityInfo only on a mix-in, single Node read (no collection/map) -> unknown via jsonIdentityInfo.any; was over-reported as reachable before the fix because the mix-in class literal became a root and a type-level annotation counted without a container
